t: Debarim haasurim mishshum binyan usetira beshabbat
s: Debarim haasurim mishshum binyan usetira beshabbat ubo k"a seipim: kebar nitbaer sheen binyan usetira bekelim sheen machaziqim arbaim sea kesheeno binyan gamur, lepikak, chabit shel cheres sheenah machazeqet arbaim sea shennishbera, vedibbeq shebareha bezepet — muttar leshabberah beshabbat, ben beyad ben bikli, kede liqqach mah shebbetokah, veen bah mishshum setira, mippene sheenah binyan gamur. Ubilbad shello yitkavven lenoqbah neqeb yapeh sheyyehe lah lepetach naeh, sheim ken hare hu metaqqen keli, vechayyab mishshum "makkeh bappattish", kemo sheyyitbaer. Abal kesheeno mitkavven lekak — muttar, velo gazeru shemma yitkavven lekak, mippene shechabit hashshebura udebuqa bezepet hi gerua beenayv, veeno choshesh aleha keshechozer veshoberah letaqqen lah petach naeh. Abal im hi shelema — asur leshabberah apillu beinyan sheeno metaqqen lah petach naeh, mippene shessetirat binyan gamur asura ap bekelim. Veod, gezera shemma yitkavven lenoqbah neqeb yapeh sheyyehe lah lepetach naeh:

Hattoqea yated bakkotel litlot bo kelim vekayyotze bazeh — chayyab mishshum boneh. Vaapillu lo taqa hayyated, ella sheqqadach chor bakkotel litqoa bo yated — chayyab mishshum boneh al neqeb zeh, hoil veneqeb zeh hu moil lebinyan, dehaynu litqiat hayyated. Veken haoseh neqeb beqarqa habbayit kede sheyyetzeu hammayim — chayyab mishshum boneh. Abal haoseh neqeb bedabar talush — eno chayyab, ella im ken hanneqeb asuy lehaknis ulehotzi bo, kegon neqeb shebbelul shel tarnegolim sheeno mechubbar laqqarqa, shehu asuy lehaknis haora ulehotzi hahebel, shenneqeb zeh hu petach gamur, vechayyabim al asiyyato mishshum tiqqun keli shehi toledet "makkeh bappattish", kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"b. Uben sheasa hanneqeb beetz, ben bematteket, ben bekelim — chayyab alayv mishshum "makkeh bappattish", im hu asuy lehaknis ulehotzi:

Vegazeru chakamim al kol neqeb, apillu asuy lehotzi bilbad o lehaknis bilbad, shemma yabo laasot neqeb shechayyabim alayv. Lepikak, en noqebim neqeb chadash bechabit sheyyazub bo hayyayin. Vaapillu haya bo neqeb uba lehosip bo meat leharchibo — asur. Vehu shemmitkavven lehosip, abal im haya sakkin taqua bechabit shel etz mibbeod yom kede sheyyazub hayyayin bimqom neqibato kesheyyotziu oto — muttar lehotzio ulehakniso beshabbat. Veap shei epshar shello yosip banneqeb al yede hotzaa zo — en bekak kelum, kevan sheeno mitkavven lehosip. Veap she"pesiq resheh velo yamut" hu, mikkol maqom, kevan sheap haoseh neqeb chadash kazeh bemitkavven en bo issur ella middibre soperim, hoil veeno asuy ella lehotzi bilbad — lepikak lo hechemiru bo kol kak leesor ap lehosip shello bemitkavven. Veyesh choleqim veomerim shello hittiru lehotzi hassakkin mehechabit beshabbat ella im ken kebar hotzio paam achat mibbeod yom, sheaz eno "pesiq resheh" sheyyosip banneqeb al yede hotzaa zo shebbeshabbat, ella epshar shello yosip kelum, veim ken ap im era shemmosip — en bekak kelum, sheddabar sheeno mitkavven hu. Vehaiqqar kasbara harishona. Umikkol maqom, bemaqom sheen sham tzorek kol kak, tob lachush lasbara haacharona:

Abal sakkin shehu tachub bekotel shel etz mibbeod yom, im hu taqua qetzat bechozeq — nahagu bo issur lehotzio beshabbat, ella im ken hotzio kebar paam achat mibbeod yom, sheaz eno "pesiq resheh" sheyyosip banneqeb. Abal kesheadayin lo hotzio meolam minneqeb zeh — i epshar shello yosip banneqeb keshemmotzio beshabbat, kevan shehaya taqua qetzat bechozeq. Velo hittiru lehosip shello bemitkavven ella bechabit, sheap laasot bah neqeb battechilla ubemitkavven — en bo issur leolam ella middibre soperim, abal haoseh neqeb bakkotel bemitkavven — chayyab chattat lipamim, dehaynu im noqebo kede litqoa bo yated. Veap hammosip kol shehu beneqeb zeh bemitkavven — chayyab, laken yesh lehachamir bo shello lehosip bo ap shello bemitkavven, keshehu "pesiq resheh". Zehu taam hamminhag. Abal min haddin en bazeh issur barur, kevan shemmikkol maqom, im haya oseh neqeb chadash bakkotel beinyan zeh mammash shehu mosip bo akshav behotzaat hassakkin, dehaynu shello al menat litqoa bah yated — lo haya bo issur min hattora, lepi shehi melaka sheenah tzerika legupah, vegam hu meqalqel hakkotel. Vegam mah shemmosip banneqeb behotzaat hassakkin zehu naaseh kilachar yad, vekol kilachar yad en bo issur kelal min hattora ap bimlaka gemura. Im ken en leesor lehosip shello bemitkavven, kemo shello aseru ken bechabit, lepi mah shennitbaer shehaiqqar kehammattirin sham. Umikkol maqom, en lehaqel neged hamminhag:

Abal sakkin hattaqua bassapsal o bishar dabar hattalush — muttar lehotzio beshabbat, ap sheadayin lo hotzio meolam, mippene shebbaasiyyat neqeb bedabar talush en bo issur leolam mishshum boneh, ella mishshum gezerat tiqqun keli, im asahu petach lehaknis o lehotzi. Abal kesheeno osehu petach kelal, lo lehaknis velo lehotzi, ella shennaaseh mimmela al yede hotzaat hassakkin — en bo issur kelal. Veim hu taqua bechabit gedola o bishar kelim gedolim shemmachaziqin arbaim sea, sheyyesh bahem binyan usetira — hare dino ketaqua bakkotel:

Chabit shehaya bah neqeb venistam, apillu setamo beyadayim beetz o bedabar acher — muttar lepotcho beshabbat. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehu lemala min hashshemarim, abal im hu keneged hashshemarim — asur lepotcho (ella im ken asuy lepotcho ulesotmo tadir, kegon barza shebbechabit), shekkevan shehu lematta kol kak, hare kol kobed hayyayin nishan alayv vetzarik setima meulla, lepikak kesheppotechah — chashub kepoteach neqeb chadash, mah sheen ken lemala min hashshemarim sheen tzarik setima meulla — eno chashub kepoteach mechadash:

Bemaqom shemmuttar liptoach neqeb yashan shennistam — muttar lenoqbo apillu bemaqdeach, kegon im nishbera habbarza shebbechabit veeno yakol lehotziah — yakol lenoqbah bemaqdeach. Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar liqqach barza acheret ulehakkot beotah barza hattechuba bah, im hu letzorek lishtot yayin beshabbat. Ubilbad shello tehe habbarza hattechuba bah neged hashshemarim, kemo shennitbaer:

Yesh omerim shello hittiru liptoach neqeb yashan ella bechabit shel cheres, sheen hassetima mehuddeqet yapeh banneqeb. Abal bechabit shel etz shemmehaddeqin meod haetz shessotemin bo hanneqeb, vechotekin rosho al daat shello lehotzio — vadday nireh shezzehu neqeb chadash veasur. Veyesh choleqin al zeh. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bimqom tzorek gadol lehaqel bedibre soperim:

Muttar litten qaneh chalul o shear barza bechabit lehotzi bahem hayyayin, ap al pi shello hayu meolam bechabit zo, veeno yodea kelal im yabou lemiddat hanneqeb shel chabit zo, veen chosheshin shemma lo yabou lemiddato veyachtekem vigordem besakkin sabib sabib ad sheyyabou lemiddato veyitchayyeb mishshum mechattek, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Abal asur litten aleh shel hadas beneqeb shebbechabit kede shello yihyeh hayyayin shotet al dopne hechabit, ella yihyeh meqalleach al healeh hamquppal veasuy keen marzeb, gezera shemma yetaqqen marzeb leyeno sheyyippol hayyayin letoko veyelek lemerachoq. Umah shello gazeru ken bintinat qaneh chalul, hu lepi shehaqqaneh en hu oseh shum maaseh begupo ella shettochabo bechabit, lepikak en gozerin shemma yabo laasot maaseh letaqqen marzeb leyeno, mah sheen ken bealeh sheoseh maaseh begupo, shelloqecho umeqappelo keen marzeb, kevan shennireh keoseh marzeb — gazeru bo shemma yabo letaqqen marzeb gamur leyeno:

Veyesh omerim sheggam bealeh lo aseru mishshum gezerat marzeb, ella mishshum gezera shemma yitqalqel aleh zeh veyiqtom aleh acher min heanap hattalush litteno beneqeb hechabit, uqetima zo asura mishshum tiqqun keli, shekkol dabar shemmetaqqeno beshabbat sheyyihyeh rauy lehishtammesh bo ezeh tashmish — yesh bo mishshum tiqqun keli, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman sh"m. Veap im healeh hu rak verauy lemaakal behema — ap al pi ken yesh issur biqtimato mishshum tiqqun keli, shello ameru okle behema en bahem mishshum tiqqun keli hoil vehen rakkin veen mitqayyemin, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shk"b, ella keshemmetaqqen haokel lihyot keli bipne atzmo, kegon sheqqotem qash lachatzotz bo shinnayv, sheeno chashub kimtaqqen keli, lepi sheen derek haokel kelal laasot mimmennu keli battechilla, kevan sheeno mitqayyem harbeh, abal derek hu letaqqen bo keli heasuy kebar, kegon litten healeh beneqeb shebbechabit haasuya kebar, lepikak kesheqqotemah lekak — yesh biqtima zo mishshum tiqqun keli. Ulepi sebara zo sheen issur bintinat healeh beneqeb shebbechabit ella mishshum shemma yiqtom — lo aseru bemaqom sheyyesh lo harbeh alin qetumim mibbeod yom, sheaz en lachush shemma yiqtom, sheap im yitqalqel echad o shenayim — hare yesh lo od, veen chosheshim shemma yitqalqelu kullam. Uleinyan halaka — bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel:

Qorea adam or sheal pi hechabit shel yayin o shear mashqeh shelletzorek hashshabbat veeno choshesh, mippene sheppesiqat talush muttar lekattechilla, kemo sheyyitbaer. Ubilbad shello yitkavven laasot keen marzeb meor haqqarua, mippene shehu kimtaqqen keli:

Mebi adam chabit shel yayin lipne haorechim umattiz roshah (perush rosh hechabit hu bimqom hammegupa, shezzehu maqom haggaboah shebbah keshehi munnachat, shessabib lemaqom zeh mikkol tzedadayv hi mashpaat veyoredet) besayip lematta mimmegupatah, dehaynu shechotek sepat piha sabib im hammegupa sheal piha. Veap sheal yede kak naaseh petach chadash lechabit — en bekak kelum, mippene shebbevadday en kavvanato kede laasot petach chadash, sheen derek kelal laasot ken lehattiz rosh hechabit bishbil asiyyat petach, ella leayin yapa hu mitkavven, leharot nedibut libbo lipne haorechim, shemmarchib lahem meqom motza hayyayin. Vehu shehechabit shebura udebuqa bezepet, vegam enah machazeqet arbaim sea, sheen bah mishshum setira, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal asur laasot neqeb begup hechabit, apillu beromach sheoseh neqeb gadol sheeno domeh lepetach, mippene shemmikkol maqom al korchaka hu mitkavven lepetach, dehaynu shemmippene sheeno chapetz liptoach hammegupa tadir, meezeh taam sheyyesh lo, lekak hu oseh neqeb zeh lehotzi bo yayin bekol et shello yachpotz liptoach hammegupa, vahare zeh petach gamur heasuy lehotzi, sheasaruhu chakamim, sheim haya mitkavven leayin yapa, haya lo liptoach hammegupa, shedderek sham yekolin lehotzi yayin yoter berevach midderek hanneqeb sheasa hu:

Abal muttar laasot neqeb bammegupa milmala lehotzi bo yayin, ap im hechabit hi shelema, lepi sheen derek kelal laasot petach bammegupa milmala, ella notel kol hammegupa. Ulepikak neqeb zeh shemmilmala eno nireh venechshab kepetach kelal. Velaken lo asaruhu bammegupa, hoil veap haoseh bah neqeb gamur lehaknis ulehotzi bo hayyayin — eno chayyab min hattora kemo haoseh bechabit atzmah, mippene shehammegupa enah chashuba chibbur lehechabit, ap keshehi netuna al piha, ella hu dabar bipne atzmo, velaken en hanneqeb shebbah qaruy asuy lehaknis ulehotzi bo, lepi shekkeshemmotzi umaknis derek hanneqeb shebbah — hare zeh keillu motzi umaknis derek pi hechabit bilbad, lepi shehanneqeb eno moil kelum lehotzaa vehaknasa zo, sheap mibbilado haya yakol lehaknis ulehotzi derek pi hechabit, veap sheppiha satum bammegupa — en zo setima gemura, hoil veen hammegupa chashuba chibbur lechabit, laken lo hechemiru bah kol kak leesor bah apillu neqeb sheeno asuy ella lehotzi bilbad, im hu asuy bemaqom sheen derek laasot sham petach, dehaynu al gabba milmala. Abal asur laasot bah neqeb betziddah, dehaynu bemaqom shehi mashpaat veyoredet, lepi shedderek hu lipamim laasot bah petach min hatztzad, kesherotzeh shettehe hechabit petucha lehotzi mimmenna yayin tadir, veeno rotzeh liptoach hammegupa, shello yippol apar o pesolet bayyayin, laken oseh bah petach patuach min hatztzad:

Abal begupah shel chabit asur laasot neqeb apillu milmala, ap sheen derek laasot sham petach, lepi shekkevan sheim haya asuy lehaknis ulehotzi — haya chayyab alayv min hattora ap sheasao milmala, lepikak gam kesheeno asuy ella lehotzi bilbad — asur middibre soperim ap sheasao milmala:

Hamchattek et haor umaqpid lechatteko bemidda hatztzerika lo, kegon shemmeqatztzeo lirtzuot vesandalim — hare zeh ab melaka, shekken bammishkan hayu mechattekim orot elim utechashim bemidda laasotan mikseh laohel. Vekol hamchattek ezeh dabar talush umaqpid lechatteko bemidda — hare zeh toledet hamchattek. Kegon haqqotem rosh hannotza shehu daq verak verauy litteno bekar o bekeset — chayyab im mitkavven lekak, mippene shemmaqpid leqotmo bemidda hareuya lo. Veken hamgared rashe kelonesot sheyyihyu shavin vechaddin — chayyab mishshum mechattek. Veken hambaqqea etzim lachatikot, im maqpid lechattekan bemidda — chayyab mishshum mechattek. Veap im eno maqpid al middatan, im mebaqqea lachatikot daqqot meod lehabir bahen haesh — chayyab mishshum tochen. Abal hambaqqea lachatikot gedolot veeno maqpid al middatan — en bo issur ella middibre soperim, mishshum shehu maaseh chol vezilzul shabbat im en bahem mishshum tiltul muqtzeh, kegon etzim hamyuchadim letashmish umukanim letaltel. Abal shear dabar talush sheen bachatikato mishshum maaseh chol — muttar lechatteko lekattechilla, kol sheeno mitkavven lachtok bemidda veeno chotek lachatikot daqqot meod, vegam hu dabar sheen bo tiqqun keli bachatikato, ukemo sheyyitbaer besiman sh"m. Lepikak, muttar lachtok qishre hashshappud sheqqosherim betaleh o op hatztzeluyim bo. Veken opot memullaim shetteparan — muttar lachtok chut hattepira:

Veken chotamot shebbakkelim, kegon shidda teba umigdal shehakkissuy shellahem qashur bahem bechebel — muttar lachtok hachebel apillu besakkin, o lehapqio, dehaynu lehattir qeliato, kede lepotcham liqqach mah shebbetokam. Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar lehattir haqqesher, shehare eno qesher shel qayyama, shehu asuy lehattiro tadir. Veap shehachebel asuy lechabber hakkissuy im hakkeli, ukeshechoteko o mapqio hare zeh soter chibburam — en bazeh mishshum setira, lepi shehachebel hu chibbur garua sheeno chazaq kol kak, ukeshessotero hare hu soter binyan garua, veen setira bekelim ella keshessoter binyan gamur. Lepikak, eno muttar lachtok ulehapqia ella bechebel vekayyotze bo, abal potechot shel etz veshel matteket shehem chazaqim — asur lehapqia uleshabber im neebad hammapteach, shezzehu setira gemura haasura ap bekelim. Veken asur lehasir hatztzirim sheachore hatteba (dehaynu haytedot shemmechabberim kissuy hatteba im dopnah meachorayim, shettochabin yated bechorim qetannim shebbishne barzellim meshullabim, echad qabua bakkissuy veechad qabua baddopen, veal yede hayyated hattaqua bishnehem yachad hem mechubbarim umeshullabim zeh im zeh, veyated zeh rosho echad ab qetzat verosho hashsheni yesh bo neqeb vetochabin bo yated qatan), mippene shehem tequim bechozeq, vahare zo setira gemura. Veken asur lehasir hachashuqim mechabit shel etz haasuya minnesarim harbeh vehem mechubbarim al yede hachashuqim shealehem, ukeshemmesir hachashuqim — hare zo setira gemura. Umikkol maqom, al yede nokri yesh lehaqel, ben bishbirat potechot, ben bahasarat hatztzirim vehachashuqim, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheen binyan usetira bekelim apillu bebinyan gamur usetira gemura, velo ameru shehammachazir delet shidda teba umigdal vetoqeah bechozeq veken hammachazir keli shel peraqim vetaqa bechozeq chayyab chattat, ella mippene shehu metaqqen keli, vechayyab mishshum "makkeh bappattish", abal keshessoter dabar hattaqua bechozeq vaapillu soter veshober keli shalem legamre — en bazeh shum issur kelal im hu letzorek hashshabbat. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem leinyan amira lenokri, im hu letzorek hashshabbat:

Chotalot shel temarim veshel gerogerot, dehaynu kelim haasuyim mikkappot temarim umannichin betokam gerogerot o temarim shello nitbashshelu bachamma sheyyigmeru sham bishshulam, im hakkissuy qashur bahem bechebel — muttar lehapqia hachebel o lechatteko, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Vaapillu gupan shel kelim ellu muttar lehapqia velachtok, mippene shebbinyan kelim ellu haasuyim mikkappot temarim hu binyan garua, sheeno asuy lehitqayyem harbeh, ukeshessotero eno ella kemi sheshshober egozim usheqedim bishbil haokel shebbahem:

Chotamot shebbaqqarqa, kegon delet shel bor sheqqashur bo bechebel — muttar lehattir haqqesher, mippene sheeno qesher shel qayyama, shehu asuy lehattiro tadir. Abal im eno yakol lehattir haqqesher — asur lehapqia qeliat hachebel o lechatteko, mishshum issur setira, shebbekol dabar hamchubbar laqqarqa yesh bo binyan usetira, apillu eno binyan gamur. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehaddelet asuya sham leqiyyum al menat shello lahasirah beshabbat, ella kesherotzeh liptoach habbor mattir haqqesher upoteach haddelet, abal eno mesirah mishsham legamre, ella hi qebua sham leezeh zeman, abal im enah asuya leqiyyum kelal — en bah mishshum setira, lo behapqaat hachebel o chatikato, velo apillu bahasarat haddelet atzmah, ella im ken hi sobebet al tzirah vehu shomet hatztzir mechoro, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"g. Umittaam zeh muttar lehasir haddap shemmesimin lipne hattannur veshoreqin oto betit meereb shabbat kemo shennitbaer besiman rn"t, mippene sheeno asuy leqiyyum kelal ella al menat lahasiro beshabbat:

Keshem sheasur liptoach kol neqeb mishshum gezerat tiqqun keli kemo shennitbaer lemala — kak asur listom kol neqeb, mippene shehu kimtaqqen keli. Lepikak, asur listom neqeb hechabit, apillu bedabar sheeno mitmareach veeno ba lide sechita, kegon sheyyistom bitzror o beqesam shehukenu letashmish mibbeod yom, sheen bahem mishshum issur tiltul. Abal im manniach ezeh okel vekol kayyotze bo betok hanneqeb kede lehatznio, venimtza hanneqeb nistam — muttar. Umuttar letalmid chakam lehaarim bedabar zeh, sheyyistom hanneqeb beezeh okel o kol kayyotze bo, veyomar lekol roeh sheeno mitkavven ella lehatznio, hoil veap im yaaseh belo haarama sheyyomar shemmitkavven listom — en kan issur ella middibre soperim, vegam kevan shehu talmid chakam lo yabo laasot belo haarama. Abal leam haaretz lo hittiru lehaarim, shemma yabo laasot belo haarama, shello yomar kelal shehu mitkavven kede lehatznio ella kede listom hanneqeb. Veyesh mattirim bazeh ap leam haaretz. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel letalmid chakam, shemmuttar lo lehaarim bedabar zeh ap bizman hazzeh sheen lanu talmide chakamim leinyan shear debarim. Vekol zeh listom hanneqeb bedabar sheen derek listom bo, abal muttar listom beetz shedderek listom bo, dehaynu listom bebarza et hanneqeb heasuy lehotzi bo yayin, apillu eno asuy lepotcho ulesotmo tadir ella leittim rechoqim, mippene sheeno nireh kimtaqqen keli bistima zo, kevan shedderek hu leolam lesotmo beetz zeh. Abal bedabar sheeno metuqqan lebarza — asur listom bo hanneqeb heasuy lehotzi bo yayin im neebda habbarza, ella im ken al yede haarama letalmid chakam, kemo shennitbaer:

Hamemareach retiyya, dehaynu shemmachaliq umashveh haggumot shebbah, veken hamemareach shaava o zepet vekol kayyotze bahen middebarim hammitmorchim ad shehecheliq penehem — hare zeh toledet memacheq et haor, dehaynu shemmegarer et hatztzemer o hassear meal haor ad shemmachaliq panayv, shehu ab melaka, shekken hayu osin bammishkan, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"b. Lepikak, en sotemin neqeb beshaava vekayyotze bah, apillu eno maknis hashshaava betok hanneqeb ella mannichah al pi hanneqeb, sheeno nireh kimtaqqen keli bistima zo, kevan sheen hassetima nikneset betok obi dopne hakkeli shebbimqom hanneqeb, ella hi al pi hakkeli miggabbo. Vegam apillu im en beshaava zo mishshum issur tiltul, kegon shehekinah letashmish mibbeod yom — ap al pi ken asur listom bah, mishshum gezera shemma yemareach hashshaava ledobqa bedopne hakkeli sebib hanneqeb ad sheyyachaliq paneha sham, veyitchayyeb mishshum memacheq. Vaapillu beshumman o beshemen ab asur listom, gezera mishshum shaava. Veasur lehaarim bekan velomar sheeno mitkavven ella lehatznio, apillu hu talmid chakam, shekkevan shebbeshaava qarob haddabar meod labo lide chiyyub chattat, sheyyishkach vimareach kedarko bechol kede shettehe hassetima mehuddeqet yapeh, laken aseru gam beshumman veshemen, gezera mishshum shaava vekayyotze bah:
